1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not substantially reduce embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __on the shed cellular material without prior culturing of the embryos__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after completion of steps (a) through (c)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and the agitation is performed for a duration of less than 2 hours__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __a sequence of steps comprising:__ exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __without prior enzymatic treatment of the shed cellular material__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from cell wall degrading enzymes that are applied after the initial agitation step__.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using magnetic particle-based separation__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field to isolate the DNA__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at the pre-germination stage__.

12. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed directly on the shed cellular material without prior embryo germination__.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA extracted from the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __prior to germination of the selected embryos__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __immediately following the selection step__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using a robotic platform that performs the agitation, DNA extraction, and genotyping steps without manual intervention__.
